name: backend
description: NestJS, zod, rxjs, Docker Compose, API testing, and observability backend pack

owns: API endpoints, DTOs, validation, and service orchestration
Backend runtime configuration and local service dependencies
Persistence integration and migration command placeholders
Structured logging, error handling, and service observability notes
doesNotOwn: Client route structure or browser UI state
Cloud infrastructure resources outside local development compose files
Design tokens or visual asset export policy
GPU shader or render pipeline concerns
handoffs: Publishes API contracts and environment variables for frontend consumers
Depends on infra for deployment, secrets, and managed services
Feeds runbook metrics and failure modes into operations docs
